Ghulam.ability_text:
== Ability ==
* [[File:AoE4 QuickStrike.png|22px]] '''Quick Strike''' (passive): Although the ability is described as 'Quickly deals a second hit after finishing an attack', it can be thought of as just an enhancement that increases its attack speed to attacking every 0.813s on average (1.625 seconds for both attacks).

The Quick Strike ability is also independent of the Ghulam's charge attack. While all Men-at-Arms have a charge attack where they gain increased speed, the Ghulam uniquely gains a damage bonus from this attack, similar to heavy cavalry. Like all Ayyubid and Abbasid Dynasty infantry, they can build [[Mangonel (Age of Empires IV)|Mangonels]] and [[Springald]]s in addition to [[Battering Ram (Age of Empires IV)|Battering Rams]] and [[Siege Tower (Age of Empires IV)|Siege Tower

* [[File:AoE4 Gallop.png|22px]] '''Gallop''' (active, requires {{4icons|Mounted Training}}): When active, base move speed is set to 2 tiles per second, and weapon range is increased by +2 for 8 seconds. This ability has a 45 second cooldown after being used. * [[File:AoE4 FirstStrike.png|22px]] '''First Strike''' (passive, requires [[Fort of the Huntress]]): Deal 3x damage when breaking stealth with an attack. This ability works with either the Huntress Stealth ability or the standard Stealth ability, and the multiplier applies to both base damage and damage increases from upgrades.

Torguud.ability_text:
== Ability ==
* [[File:Khan Guard AoE4.png|22px]] '''Khan Guard''' (Passive) - While [[Batu Khan]] is within four tiles of a Torguud, any damage taken by him is redirected to the Torguud. A floating icon will be displayed above the Torguud that is taking damage for the Khan. The first Torguud that is within range will be initially selected, after which this Torguud will continue taking damage until it either dies or moves out of the four-tile range. At this point, the ability switches to the Torguud nearest to the Khan. The Torguud will also passively heal Batu Khan at the rate of 2.5 hit points every five seconds.
